title: Nebulous Particle Swarm
description: A dense cloud of thousands of multicolored translucent circles floats against a solid black background. Soft, smoky, ethereal wisps in muted purple and grey drift around and through the glowing particle formation.
prompt: abstract composition of thousands of overlapping translucent circles in varied muted and vibrant hues including purple, gold, teal, orange and pink, forming an organic cloud-like mass against deep black, with soft smoky ethereal wisps weaving through the particles, mysterious atmospheric lighting, high detail, painterly digital art
